name: ElasticSearch
description: Elasticsearch is free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine.
composeYaml:
services:
  elasticsearch:
    image: 'docker.elastic.co/elasticsearch/elasticsearch-wolfi:8.19.0'
    environment:
      - 'ELASTIC_PASSWORD=${ELASTICSEARCH_PASSWORD}'
      - 'ES_JAVA_OPTS=-Xms512m -Xmx512m'
      - discovery.type=single-node
      - bootstrap.memory_lock=true
      - xpack.security.http.ssl.enabled=false
    volumes:
      - 'elasticsearch-data:/usr/share/elasticsearch/data'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - 'curl --user elastic:${ELASTICSEARCH_PASSWORD} --silent --fail http://localhost:9200/_cluster/health'
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 24

meta.about: Distributed, RESTful search and analytics engine.
